cards.def:
Channels of communication that inform and shape public opinion.
हिंदी: मीडिया / संचार माध्यम
examples: Media is called the fourth pillar of democracy.
Media can spread both truth and falsehood.

cards.def:
The profession of gathering and reporting news.
हिंदी: पत्रकारिता
examples: Journalism faces threats in many countries.

cards.def:
The journalistic practice of searching out and publicly exposing corruption and scandals.
हिंदी: भ्रष्टाचार-उजागर पत्रकारिता
examples: Muckraking journalism in the early twentieth century led to landmark consumer protection laws.
The courageous reporter engaged in muckraking to expose illegal chemical dumping in the river.
Democratic accountability thrives when investigative muckraking holds power to account.
Muckraking articles revealed widespread bribery inside the municipal building department.

cards.def:
False information spread deliberately to deceive.
हिंदी: दुष्प्रचार / जानबूझकर फैलाई झूठी सूचना
examples: Disinformation is spread to manipulate opinion.

cards.def:
False stories presented as real news.
हिंदी: फ़र्ज़ी ख़बर
examples: Fake News spreads through social media.
Fake News erodes trust in media.

cards.def:
The practice of masking the sponsors of a message to make it appear as a genuine grassroots movement.
हिंदी: नक़ली जन-समर्थन अभियान
examples: Corporate lobbyists engaged in astroturfing to create fake public support for the pipeline.
Astroturfing campaigns deploy automated bot armies on social media platforms.
Investigative journalists exposed the political rally as an orchestrated act of astroturfing.
Astroturfing manipulates public opinion by manufacturing false popular consensus.

cards.def:
Media free from government control.
हिंदी: स्वतंत्र प्रेस
examples: Free Press is essential for democracy.

cards.def:
The right of journalists to report without interference.
हिंदी: प्रेस की आज़ादी
examples: Press Freedom is protected by Article 19.
Press Freedom is declining in some nations.

cards.def:
Unfair preference in reporting toward one side.
हिंदी: मीडिया का पक्षपात

Exaggerated reporting to attract attention.
हिंदी: सनसनीखेज़ी

Reporting based on sensationalism and little facts.
हिंदी: पीत पत्रकारिता

A column expressing personal views, opposite the editorial page.
हिंदी: विचार-लेख (संपादकीय पृष्ठ के सामने)
examples: Op-Eds are written by guest authors.

cards.def:
A short, memorable phrase from a speech or interview.
हिंदी: संक्षिप्त उद्धरण / छोटा बयान

Biased interpretation of events to favor a side.
हिंदी: तोड़-मरोड़ कर पेश करना
examples: Spin is used by political parties.

cards.def:
A person who shapes public perception of events.
हिंदी: छवि सुधारने वाला प्रचारक

A story or framework used to interpret events.
हिंदी: कथानक / प्रस्तुत कहानी

The way information is presented to influence perception.
हिंदी: प्रस्तुति का ढंग / मुद्दे को गढ़ना
examples: Framing affects how people interpret news.
Framing can highlight or hide facts.

cards.def:
The media's power to decide which issues matter.
हिंदी: एजेंडा तय करना
examples: Agenda Setting can ignore important issues.

cards.def:
The process of filtering what news reaches the public.
हिंदी: द्वारपाल की भूमिका / ख़बर छानने की प्रक्रिया
examples: Gatekeeping decides which stories are published.

cards.def:
A body that reviews and restricts content.
हिंदी: सेंसर बोर्ड
examples: The Censorship Board restricts explicit content.
The Censorship Board must be fair.

cards.def:
Laws safeguarding personal data.
हिंदी: डेटा सुरक्षा
examples: Data Protection prevents misuse of information.

cards.def:
The right of citizens to access official data and public records held by government entities.
हिंदी: सूचना की स्वतंत्रता
examples: Freedom of information enhances transparency and holds elected officials accountable.
Reporters used freedom of information laws to reveal government misspending.
Freedom of information is vital for an informed, self-governing citizenry.
Exceptions to freedom of information must be narrowly tailored for national defense.

cards.def:
A person who exposes wrongdoing within an organization.
हिंदी: भंडाफोड़ करने वाला / मुखबिर

Public judgment of a case by media before court verdict.
हिंदी: मीडिया ट्रायल
examples: Trial by Media violates fair trial.
Trial by Media prejudices public opinion.
Trial by Media must be avoided.
Trial by Media harms the accused.

cards.def:
The collective views of the population.
हिंदी: जनमत
examples: Public Opinion is influenced by media.

cards.def:
A survey measuring public views.
हिंदी: जनमत सर्वेक्षण

A survey of voters after they vote.
हिंदी: एग्ज़िट पोल / मतदान उपरांत सर्वेक्षण
examples: Exit Polls are regulated in India.

cards.def:
Online platforms for sharing content and opinions.
हिंदी: सोशल मीडिया

A concerted effort to damage someone's reputation by spreading malicious or false rumors.
हिंदी: बदनाम करने का अभियान
examples: The opposition candidate became the target of an orchestrated online smear campaign.
Smear campaigns distract voters from substantive political issues and economic policies.
Courts awarded heavy damages after finding the newspaper guilty of a deliberate smear campaign.
Investigative reporters uncovered the public relations firm behind the anonymous smear campaign.

cards.def:
An online space where algorithms show only familiar views.
हिंदी: फ़िल्टर बबल
examples: Filter Bubbles limit exposure to new ideas.
Filter Bubbles are created by algorithms.

cards.def:
Posting abusive or provocative content online.
हिंदी: ट्रोलिंग

Speech attacking a group based on identity.
हिंदी: नफ़रत भरा भाषण
examples: Hate Speech is restricted by law.

cards.def:
Verifying the accuracy of information.
हिंदी: तथ्य-जाँच

The ability to analyze and evaluate media content.
हिंदी: मीडिया साक्षरता
examples: Media Literacy should be taught in schools.

cards.def:
The media as a check on power.
हिंदी: चौथा स्तंभ
examples: The Fourth Estate holds power accountable.
The Fourth Estate must be independent.

cards.def:
In-depth reporting to uncover hidden truths.
हिंदी: खोजी पत्रकारिता
examples: Investigative Journalism takes time and resources.

cards.def:
Reporters attached to military units during conflict.
हिंदी: सैन्य दल के साथ जुड़ी पत्रकारिता
examples: Embedded Journalism is used in wars.

cards.def:
A journalist reporting from conflict zones.
हिंदी: युद्ध संवाददाता
examples: War Correspondents report from the front.
War Correspondents bring truth to light.

cards.def:
News reporting by ordinary people.
हिंदी: नागरिक पत्रकारिता

A system requiring payment to access content.
हिंदी: पेवॉल / भुगतान की दीवार
examples: Paywalls are common in digital media.

cards.def:
Sensational headlines designed to attract clicks.
हिंदी: क्लिकबेट / ध्यान खींचने वाली सुर्ख़ी

Reviewing and removing harmful online content.
हिंदी: सामग्री पर नियंत्रण / कंटेंट मॉडरेशन
examples: Content Moderation faces free speech concerns.
Content Moderation is done by platforms.

cards.def:
The use of information to influence or attack an opponent.
हिंदी: सूचना युद्ध
examples: Information Warfare is used in elections.
